items.title: What Happens To ExxonMobil Stock If Refining Profits Fade?
items.summary: The worry for ExxonMobil (XOM) holders is that its refineries stop earning high margins. Management said in late July that the Strait closure keeps about 3 million barrels a day of refining capacity off the market. The second quarter alone supplied $14.5 billion of the $32.8 billion ExxonMobil earned over the last twelve months. How much of that profit rests on refining, and what would you lose if its margins fell back.

items.title: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) Faces Fresh Uncertainty After Trump Backs Diesel Export Ban
items.summary: Marathon Petroleum (NYSE:MPC) faced fresh policy risk after Donald Trump backed a possible US diesel export ban in recent remarks. The former president said he supports restricting US diesel shipments abroad, raising questions for domestic refiners that sell into global markets. Such a ban could pressure refining economics by limiting diesel outlets, which are a key revenue stream for large US refineries.
